WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, p.subcategory AS sub_as_was,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, n.category_as_was, n.sub_as_was, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND n.category_as_was ILIKE '%garden%' OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.sub_as_was ILIKE '%light%')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, MIN(sale_date) AS mn, MAX(sale_date) AS mx, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date), 0
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-05-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'periods', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_period), 0, MIN(period_start_date), MAX(period_end_date), SUM(CASE WHEN fully_loaded THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, ROUND(m.mine,2) AS mine, ROUND(c.ctrl,2) AS ctrl, ROUND(m.mine-c.ctrl,2) AS gap
FROM mine m JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1
